title.en: Printed-row question: Tractor 4100 or the 17 kW pump for a village house
title.zh: 先看已印出的行：村镇住宅选拖拉机4100还是 17 kW 泵

description.en: Taken from the printed row: Use the 17 kW rural diesel when 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal and 10–30 m vertical are enough. Keep this cell as published. Use the tractor-driven 4100 when you need 6–12 m³/h and the wider 40–100 m / 15–45 m window, and you can use the printed 40 kW tractor drive. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists both for rural self-built houses. Read it in the Xingtai table. Neither is Diesel 120.
description.zh: 5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m 够用时，用 17 kW 农村柴油泵。需要 6–12 m³/h 和更宽的 40–100 m / 15–45 m，并且能用已印的 40 kW 拖拉机带动时，用 4100。河北品锦机械（邢台）把两台都列为农村自建房。两台都不是柴油120。

h1.en: Printed-row question: Tractor 4100 or the 17 kW pump for a village house
h1.zh: 先看已印出的行：村镇住宅选拖拉机4100还是 17 kW 泵

directAnswer.en: Taken from the printed row: Use the 17 kW rural diesel when 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal and 10–30 m vertical are enough. Keep this cell as published. Use the tractor-driven 4100 when you need 6–12 m³/h and the wider 40–100 m / 15–45 m window, and you can use the printed 40 kW tractor drive. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists both for rural self-built houses. Read it in the Xingtai table. Neither is Diesel 120.
directAnswer.zh: 5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m 够用时，用 17 kW 农村柴油泵。需要 6–12 m³/h 和更宽的 40–100 m / 15–45 m，并且能用已印的 40 kW 拖拉机带动时，用 4100。河北品锦机械（邢台）把两台都列为农村自建房。两台都不是柴油120。

body.en: The reference page “Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption” uses “Fan Power Consumption” as one of its own divisions. What follows is the Xingtai row, said again in different words. Taken from the printed row: Both are off-grid rural rows. Keep this cell as published. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai lists both for rural self-built houses. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Shared pressure and stone still leave two distance tables. Read it in the Xingtai table. Say whether a tractor is available. Taken from the printed row: The 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h. Image from the source page: https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fans-efficiency-power-consumption-d_197.html
body.zh: 来源页《Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption》用“功率消耗”划分这一节。后面是邢台目录里已有内容，换一种说法写下。目录里已经写着：两台都是无电网农村行。17 kW 泵是 5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m。4100 是 6–12 m³/h、40–100 m / 15–45 m，并有坍落度格。这一格照已印出的读：请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。图来自来源页面：https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/fans-efficiency-power-consumption-d_197.html

body.en: “Fan Efficiency” is an outline label from “Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption”. That label does not add a figure to the printed row. Keep this cell as published. The 17 kW pump is 5–8 m³/h and 30–50 m horizontal. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Neither is Diesel 120. Read it in the Xingtai table. The rural diesel outline is 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm. Taken from the printed row: That decides the 4100 more clearly than the word “village”. Keep this cell as published. The rural diesel prints 5–8 m³/h.
body.zh: “效率”是《Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption》大纲上的标题。这个标题不给已印出的行增加数字。这一格照已印出的读：5–8 m³/h、水平 30–50 m、垂直 10–30 m 够用时，用 17 kW 农村柴油泵。需要 6–12 m³/h 和更宽的 40–100 m / 15–45 m，并且能用已印的 40 kW 拖拉机带动时，用 4100。邢台河北品锦机械把两台都列为农村自建房。两台都不是柴油120。旁边那一台不在这句话里。4100 印 6–12 m³/h。农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。

body.en: This block keeps the heading “Power Consumption - Imperial Units” from “Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption”, then stays with the cells already published. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. The 4100 is 6–12 m³/h and 40–100 m / 15–45 m, with a slump cell. Read it in the Xingtai table. Only the 4100 prints 180–220 mm. Taken from the printed row: The 4100 outline is 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm. Keep this cell as published. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Yes.
body.zh: 本节保留《Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption》的标题“功率消耗英制单位”，正文仍只谈已经公布的格子。旁边那一台不在这句话里。只有 4100 印了 180–220 mm。17 kW 泵印了料斗 0.2 m³ 和 800 kg，4100 是 0.25 m³ 和 1300 kg。骨料 1–3 cm 和 15 MPa 两台都有。压力和石子相同，仍然是两张距离表。按邢台表上的原文理解：是。距离仍然不同。

body.en: The section shape comes from “Fan and Installation Loss (System Loss)” in “Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption”. The sentences are a restatement of the catalogue, not of that article. Read it in the Xingtai table. Use the 17 kW rural diesel when 5–8 m³/h, 30–50 m horizontal and 10–30 m vertical are enough. Taken from the printed row: The 17 kW pump prints hopper 0.2 m³ and 800 kg, against the 4100’s 0.25 m³ and 1300 kg. Keep this cell as published. The longer machine is the 4100. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Read it in the Xingtai table. Distances still differ.
body.zh: 这一节的形状来自《Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption》的“就位损失系统损失”。文字是目录的转述，不是那篇文章的原文。按邢台表上的原文理解：农村柴油泵外形是 2200 × 1100 × 1250 mm。4100 外形是 2900 × 1000 × 1350 mm。更长的是 4100。短的村镇管路不需要仅仅因为两页都写了“农村”就用更长的机架。目录里已经写着：没有。

body.en: “Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption” breaks its subject at “Fan and Temperature Increase”. Here the same break only holds the cells this model already prints. Taken from the printed row: Use the tractor-driven 4100 when you need 6–12 m³/h and the wider 40–100 m / 15–45 m window, and you can use the printed 40 kW tractor drive. Keep this cell as published. Aggregate 1–3 cm and 15 MPa appear on both. The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. A short village line does not need the longer frame just because both pages say “rural”. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue leaves that cell blank for. Taken from the printed row: No. Headings already printed: Slump is the extra 4100 cell Frame width is 1100 mm versus 1000 mm
body.zh: 《Fans - Efficiency and Power Consumption》在“温度”处把题目拆开。这里这一段只放这台机器已经印出的格子。目录里已经写着：请说明有没有拖拉机。这比“村镇”两个字更能决定 4100。已印出的标题：坍落度是 4100 多出来的一格 机架宽度是 1100 mm 对 1000 mm

question.en: Which output is higher, once the outline says “Fan Power Consumption”?
question.zh: 大纲写着“功率消耗”时，哪一台输送量更高？

answer.en: Taken from the printed row: The 4100 prints 6–12 m³/h. The rural diesel prints 5–8 m³/h.
answer.zh: 目录里已经写着：4100 印 6–12 m³/h。农村柴油泵印 5–8 m³/h。

question.en: Under “Fan Efficiency”, do they share secondary structure?
question.zh: 在“效率”这一节里，它们都写了二次结构吗？

answer.en: Keep this cell as published. Yes. Distances still differ.
answer.zh: 这一格照已印出的读：是。距离仍然不同。

question.en: What should stay printed beside “Power Consumption - Imperial Units” — Is fuel consumption printed?
question.zh: “功率消耗英制单位”旁边仍要印着的是什么：印了油耗吗？

answer.en: The neighbouring machine is not this sentence. No.
answer.zh: 旁边那一台不在这句话里。没有。
